description: This file defines a UUID package in Go, implementing UUID parsing, validation, string formatting, and related utilities, including support for RFC 4122 UUIDs and different formats.

classes.name: UUID
classes.description: A 16-byte array representing a UUID as per RFC 4122.

classes.name: Version
classes.description: Byte type representing the UUID version.

classes.name: Variant
classes.description: Byte type representing the UUID variant.

classes.name: invalidLengthError
classes.description: Custom error type for invalid UUID length.

classes.name: UUIDs
classes.description: Slice of UUIDs with a method to return string representations.

methods.name: IsInvalidLengthError
methods.description: Checks if an error is of type invalidLengthError.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a string into a UUID, supporting multiple formats.

methods.name: ParseBytes
methods.description: Parses a byte slice into a UUID, supporting multiple formats.

methods.name: MustParse
methods.description: Parses a string into a UUID or panics on error.

methods.name: FromBytes
methods.description: Creates a UUID from a byte slice, returning error if invalid.

methods.name: Must
methods.description: Returns UUID if no error, panics otherwise.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates if a string is a properly formatted UUID.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the standard string representation of the UUID.

methods.name: URN
methods.description: Returns the URN string form of the UUID.

methods.name: encodeHex
methods.description: Encodes a UUID into hexadecimal string with hyphens.

methods.name: Variant
methods.description: Returns the variant of the UUID.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns the version of the UUID.

methods.name: SetRand
methods.description: Sets the random number generator for UUID creation.

methods.name: EnableRandPool
methods.description: Enables internal randomness pool for UUID v4 generation.

methods.name: DisableRandPool
methods.description: Disables internal randomness pool for UUID v4 generation.

methods.name: Strings
methods.description: Returns string representations of a slice of UUIDs.
